description: Hand freehire a link to a vacancy or an ATS company career board (the same intake the website and CLI use). If the posting already exists you get its slug back; if we can read the page it is imported into the catalogue; if the company's board is one we do not crawl yet, it is queued for onboarding. The answer's status is one of found, tracked, imported, review or queued. Check sent links later with my_contributions.

url.description: The job posting or company career board URL to contribute.

name: contribute
